title: Zone table
description: A time zone's UTC offsets over a span, as a table of transitions (REQ-TZ-020, ADR-112). The element computes it with `Intl.DateTimeFormat` for the zone of `timeZone` over the data's time extent and the view; the CLI builds the same table from the system's tzdata (REQ-TZ-040). The core reads no clock, zone or tzdata (REQ-TZ-010): local-time ticks and labels convert by this table, so a frame is a function of its inputs. A pan past `covering` asks the shell for a wider table.

name.description: The zone as `timeZone` named it: `UTC`, a fixed offset (`+05:30`) or an IANA name (`America/New_York`).

transitions.description: Each change of offset, sorted by `at` strictly increasing. The first is at or before `covering[0]`, so every instant in the span has an offset: the offset of the last transition at or before it. A zone with one offset has one transition.

items.description: From `at` on, local time is UTC plus `offset`.

at.description: The instant the offset starts, in epoch ms (UTC).

offset.description: Local time minus UTC, in minutes: -300 for US Eastern standard time, 330 for India.

covering.description: The span [from, to] the table is good for, in epoch ms.
